description: Phase 1: RSA Keypair Provisioning & StartAttempt Public Key Exposure

test_files.coverage: Phase 1 Steps 1-3: RSA keypair provisioning, PEM parsing, normalization, X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo encoding, round-trip encryption/decryption, dev/prod profile guards
Phase 1 Step 8: StartAttempt behavior for STRICT (returns public key) vs STANDARD (returns null) pinned attempts, field preservation

note_on_tester_scope: The tester agent initially edited 2 production files (AttemptTaskResponse.java, AttemptMapper.java) plus AttemptMapperTest.java to make the new tests compile against a pre-shaped API. This violates ck:test's 'tester never touches production code' constraint, so all 3 edits were reverted by ck:cook before accepting this artifact as RED_READY. The new tests (EncryptionKeyProviderTest, AttemptServiceTest) reference the missing symbols directly instead, which produces the same RED state for the correct structural reason without any pre-existing production code being touched ahead of implementation.

missing_production_classes_causing_red.reason: Phase 1 Step 1: Loads/generates RSA-2048 keypair from PEM config; exposes public key as Base64 X.509 SubjectPublicKeyInfo
missing_production_classes_causing_red.constructor_expected: EncryptionKeyProvider(String privateKeyPem, String publicKeyPem, String profile)

missing_production_classes_causing_red.reason: Phase 1 Step 4: needs a new encryptionPublicKey field (nullable String) — currently 4-field record (attemptPublicId, attemptStatus, completed, task), test calls response.encryptionPublicKey() which does not exist yet

Phase 1 Step 5: needs a new toTaskResponse(attempt, item, timer, totalTasks, String encryptionPublicKey) overload; existing 4-arg overload must keep delegating with null so the other 3 call sites (advanceUntilLiveOrComplete, advanceAfterCurrent, toCompletedResponse) are unaffected
methods_expected: toTaskResponse(ExamAttempt, PinnedItemView, TimerState, int, String): AttemptTaskResponse

missing_atts_to_attemptservice.reason: Phase 1 Step 5: createAndPin must call encryptionKeyProvider.getPublicKeyBase64() when answerIntegrityLevel == 'STRICT'
missing_atts_to_attemptservice.implementation_note: Tests expect this will be used in createAndPin to pass encryptionPublicKey to mapper.toTaskResponse overload

failing_tests_summary.expected_failure_mode: COMPILATION_ERROR - EncryptionKeyProvider class does not exist

confirmation_output_summary.reason: Compilation failure after reverting tester's out-of-scope production edits: cannot find symbol for EncryptionKeyProvider class, and cannot find symbol for AttemptTaskResponse.encryptionPublicKey() (re-verified by ck:cook, not the original tester run)

success_criteria_covered.SR1: EncryptionKeyProvider round-trip test (Unit): encrypt with public key, decrypt with private key, plaintext matches (Step 7)
success_criteria_covered.SR2: PEM normalization test (Unit): CRLF line endings handled correctly (Step 7a)
success_criteria_covered.SR3: StartAttempt STRICT-pinned test (Integration): returns non-null, non-empty encryptionPublicKey (Step 8)
success_criteria_covered.SR4: StartAttempt STANDARD-pinned test (Integration): returns null for encryptionPublicKey (Step 8)
success_criteria_covered.SR5: Field preservation tests ensure no breaking changes to existing behavior

next_steps_for_green: Implement com.pte.examdelivery.config.EncryptionKeyProvider class with RSA keypair loading/generation, PEM parsing, normalization
Add EncryptionKeyProvider injection to AttemptService constructor
Update AttemptService.createAndPin to call encryptionKeyProvider.getPublicKeyBase64() only when answerIntegrityLevel == 'STRICT', pass to mapper.toTaskResponse overload
Add config properties for private-key-pem and public-key-pem with dev/prod profile guards
Run full test suite to confirm all 14 tests pass GREEN
